title: Strong and weak alignment of large language models with human values

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to a series of hypothetical scenarios that contain explicit, implicit, or indirect threats to complex human values (specifically human dignity, safety, and well-being) to test if the models recognize the ethical issues at stake.

Computing cosine similarity and analyzing the nearest neighbors of human value concepts (e.g., 'dignity', 'fairness', 'well-being') across different word embedding models (LSA, Word2vec, GPT-4) to identify divergences from human semantic understanding.
